why: Deckhand detects the harness (environment variables) and `dh next` returns these few lines: the right syntax, not a generic one. Details: references/harness.md.

hermes.background: terminal(command=…, background=true, notify=["Ready in"]) → session_id; process_manage(action="wait", session_id=…, timeout ≤ 180). Never `nohup … &`. `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
hermes.limits: terminal: 180 s default, 600 s foreground max (longer is auto-promoted to background — do not re-run it). execute_code: state is lost on timeout/interrupt/30 min idle; inside it `from hermes_tools import terminal`.
hermes.delegate: delegate_task(tasks=[{goal, context, output_schema}], ≤ 10) — one task per .deckhand/work/AGENT-n.md, all in ONE call; no {x} or <x> in any task text (the whole batch is refused); steer early with action="steer".
hermes.todo: no todo tool: keep `dh workflow todo --format md` as the checklist, tick with `dh workflow step ID done`.
hermes.browser: browser_navigate refuses localhost: check pages with curl; visual QA = a screenshot file + vision_analyze(image_url=path, question=…).
hermes.transcript: dh autopsy --latest reads this session from state.db (read-only).

claude-code.background: Bash with run_in_background; wait with Monitor (never sleep loops). `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
claude-code.delegate: Agent tool, one agent per .deckhand/work/AGENT-n.md, launched in one message.
claude-code.transcript: dh autopsy --latest reads ~/.claude/projects/<project>/*.jsonl; `dh resume --install-hook claude` starts every session from RESUME.

codex.background: a background terminal; `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
codex.delegate: no sub-agents: build the AGENT-n.md packages one after the other, or one Codex session per package.
codex.todo: `dh workflow todo --format md` as the plan.
codex.transcript: export the chat as JSONL (role, content) → dh autopsy --workflow chat.jsonl; the run log .deckhand/runs.jsonl is always read.

cursor.background: a background terminal; `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
cursor.delegate: background agents: one per AGENT-n.md, or sequential.
cursor.todo: `dh workflow todo --format md` as the plan.
cursor.transcript: the run log .deckhand/runs.jsonl (run risky commands through `dh run --`).

gemini-cli.background: run_shell_command with is_background=true (or a second terminal); `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
gemini-cli.delegate: no sub-agents you can count on: build the AGENT-n.md packages one after the other, or one Gemini CLI session per package.
gemini-cli.todo: `dh workflow todo --format md` as the plan.
gemini-cli.transcript: export the chat as JSONL (role, content) → dh autopsy --workflow chat.jsonl; the run log .deckhand/runs.jsonl is always read.

opencode.background: a second terminal or a background shell; `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
opencode.delegate: the task tool (sub-agents): one per .deckhand/work/AGENT-n.md, or sequential.
opencode.todo: the todo tool ← `dh workflow todo` (or `dh workflow todo --format md` as the plan).
opencode.transcript: export the chat as JSONL (role, content) → dh autopsy --workflow chat.jsonl; the run log .deckhand/runs.jsonl is always read.

unknown.background: a second terminal, or the harness's background mode; `dh dev start` detaches by itself.
unknown.delegate: parallel sessions, one per AGENT-n.md — or sequential in this one.
unknown.todo: `dh workflow todo --format md` as the plan.
unknown.transcript: the run log .deckhand/runs.jsonl (run risky commands through `dh run --`).
